PROMISE_RING.title: Promise Ring
PROMISE_RING.description:
At the start of each combat, [gold]Rika[/gold] stays at your side, partially manifested.
At the start of the run, add a [gold]Full Manifestation[/gold] to your deck.
Rika can store up to [blue]5[/blue] [gold]Techniques[/gold] (copied cards), usable only during Full Manifestation.{CardTitles.StringValue:cond:

Stored Techniques:
{}|}
PROMISE_RING.flavor: A childhood promise, now the bond that keeps her close.
PROMISE_RING.rewardDescription: Store a [gold]Technique[/gold] in the Promise Ring
JUJUTSU_HIGH_UNIFORM.title: Jujutsu High Uniform
JUJUTSU_HIGH_UNIFORM.flavor: The white uniform of Tokyo Jujutsu High. Yuta is the only student who wears white.
SWORD_BAG.title: Sword Bag
SWORD_BAG.description: The first Attack you play each combat deals [blue]{Damage}[/blue] additional damage per hit.
INUMAKI_MEGAPHONE.title: Inumaki's Megaphone
INUMAKI_MEGAPHONE.flavor: Bears the Inumaki clan's "Snake Eyes and Fangs" crest. Rika pulled it out from within herself.
CURSED_KATANA.title: Cursed Katana
CURSED_KATANA.description: During [gold]Full Manifestation[/gold], your Attacks deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] additional damage per hit.
CURSED_KATANA.flavor: A blade infused with cursed energy. Sharper still when that energy is all but limitless.
SPECIAL_GRADE_LICENSE.title: Special Grade License
SPECIAL_GRADE_LICENSE.description: During [gold]Full Manifestation[/gold], gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn.
SPECIAL_GRADE_LICENSE.flavor: There are only four special grade sorcerers in all of Japan.
RIKAS_PHOTO.title: Rika's Photo
RIKAS_PHOTO.description: At the start of each combat, if [gold]Rika[/gold] has stored [gold]Techniques[/gold], choose 1 to add to your [gold]hand[/gold]. It costs 0 this turn.
RIKAS_PHOTO.flavor: Taken six years ago. In it she is still the girl who promised to marry him.
YAGAS_CURSED_CORPSE.title: Yaga's Cursed Corpse
YAGAS_CURSED_CORPSE.flavor: Made by Principal Yaga himself. Rumor has it that it moves on its own.
